about: Every fact a criterion of grille@1 reads. m.* comes from measure (one commit, offline), x.* from snapshot (the network), p.* from the declared profile, d.* is derived by score from the others. A fact marked mechanized: false is not collected by runward-assess 0.1.0: it is never inferred, and a criterion that needs it reads not-observed, with this procedure as its reason.
